text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Tachyon-san... is just so 
fast...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuugh... *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm sorry for making you worry. 
Somehow... to the best of my ability...
choice_data_list: So... what about this "friend" of yours?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...There's... no mistake. I'm standing... 
right in front of Tachyon-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san is the closest to me right 
now. It seems I have no choice... but to 
keep chasing after her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Competing with that person... and using 
that as a guidepost...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her goal of chasing her "friend" meshes 
perfectly with the Classic Triple Crown 
path. From here on, if she just keeps 
chasing Agnes Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh! I see, 
Cafe...! So this is who you are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, splendid! No, terrible, but 
splendid! An unexpected success and an 
expected failure cancel each other out, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This works. The world tends to operate by 
process of elimination anyway. Heh heh, 
fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After having a hearty laugh, Agnes Tachyon 
looked up at the sky and muttered 
something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Tachyon. That is... a hypothetical 
particle said to always travel faster than 
the speed of light.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet even virtually, it ought to be 
displayed. The afterglow birthed from 
madness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—The Satsuki Sho. After combustion, a 
glorious remnant is sure to be born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—that night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I'm going to chase 
Tachyon-san... the next race is the 
Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I considered continuing on the Triple 
Crown path, but I paused to think it 
through calmly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That fearless attitude of Agnes Tachyon's 
earlier today. And then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuuu... *cough*, uuu...
choice_data_list: Didn't today's race take a lot out of you?
Didn't today's race take a toll on you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... A little...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's fierce run took a heavy toll on 
her gaunt frame. No matter how clearly the 
path ahead has revealed itself, aiming for 
the upcoming G1 is simply asking too much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well then... the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is definitely a race I 
want to see Manhattan Cafe win no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if we make that our goal, whether we 
can surpass it is an all-or-nothing 
gamble...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so sorry, Trainer... All 
because... I was so pathetic..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to... lean on your 
kindness... When this is... such a crucial 
moment... *cough*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a moment to calm down and think. If 
I want her to achieve greatness over 
time...
choice_data_list: Let's go for the autumn St. Lite Kinen

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Autumn... The Kikuka Sho prep race... 
Until then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But... then... Um... at least the Derby...
choice_data_list:
Let's wait and see how things go before 
deciding.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Let's see how things go...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes, only if we make it in time, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Target the St. Lite Kinen, and the 
Japanese Derby if possible. That was the 
best roadmap I could draw up as a Trainer.
